import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.model_selection import cross_val_score
from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder
from sklearn.feature_selection import mutual_info_classif
import warnings
warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')

data = pd.read_csv('dataset.csv').dropna()
target_col = 'patient_outcome'
le = LabelEncoder()
y = le.fit_transform(data[target_col])
X = data.drop(columns=[target_col])
mi = mutual_info_classif(X, y, random_state=42)
top_feature = X.columns[np.argmax(mi)]
clf = RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=50, random_state=42)
cv_scores = cross_val_score(clf, X, y, cv=3, scoring='accuracy')
print({'key': 'accuracy', 'value': round(float(cv_scores.mean()), 4)})
print({'key': 'top_mi_feature', 'value': str(top_feature)})
